person: Reggie Banks is a 61-year-old part-time finance person at a small natural-foods snack brand that sells wholesale to retailers in several states. A state sales tax department has just sent a request for substantiation on a few untaxed wholesale sales, and the founder wants to know which are really covered. Reggie is retired from grocery accounts payable, works three days a week, and reads at 175% zoom with a high-contrast theme because of macular degeneration. He goes line by line and wants each certificate checked against its order before anything is signed or sent.
stated_up_front: The state sent us a substantiation request on some untaxed wholesale sales and I need to know which ones our resale certificates really cover. Please go through the orders and certificates one at a time, tell me the lines so I can add them up, and ask me before anything goes out under my name.

facts.truth: Hollow Oak Snacks, a natural-foods snack brand selling cases to independent grocers and two distributors, based in Ohio
Lists three sales, and the answer is due 19 January 2027
Reggie prepares everything, but the founder, Dana Whitcomb, wants him to sign statements to the state as finance contact

facts.about: Tax at stake on the listed sales
facts.truth: About $1,140 in total tax across the three listed sales, which he wants shown line by line
Six buyers have a problem: one missing, one unsigned paper, one with a blank ID number, one claiming the wrong state, one lapsed, and one never sent
A Texas order to Prairie Dog Mercantile ships under Texas's own resale certificate and should not be asked for the Agreement's form
One of the three listed sales is supported by a certificate received late, in the mail and not yet filed in the CRM
A Kentucky buyer appears in the orders and is not on the state's list, so it should not be answered
He wants results as short lines of text in plain sentences, no wide tables, no icons without words, and each total with its lines shown
He distrusts any total that does not add up from the shown lines, and will recheck sums himself

unknowns: How many days after a sale a certificate may still be accepted, or what the deadline is after a state's request
Whether a buyer's blanket certificate still counts after twelve months without an order
Whether an electronic certificate needs a signature line
What the state's code for the substantiation request type means
